premier_pos.title: Point of sale
premier_pos.scopeRequired: Select an organization to start selling.
premier_pos.offline: Connection lost. Payment requires a verified server response; your current cart remains available in this tab.
premier_pos.configRequired: Configure a sales channel and currency before creating sales.
premier_pos.chooseSetup: Choose a sales channel and currency to load products.
premier_pos.emptyProducts: No matching products are available in this sales channel.
premier_pos.emptyCart: Select products to start a sale.
premier_pos.paymentPending: Payment has not been confirmed yet.
premier_pos.checkoutError: Checkout could not be confirmed. The saved IDs are retained; verify the order before starting another sale. A money request is never repeated automatically.
premier_pos.previewError: Cart totals could not be verified. Check prices, quantities and selected organization.
premier_pos.receiptNote: Recorded payment only; shipment and warehouse execution follow the configured native workflow.
premier_pos.traceDescription: Read official order, invoice, payment, shipment, and WMS movement records
premier_pos.traceMovements: WMS movements directly referencing this order
premier_pos.traceUnavailable: Records unavailable or you lack permission to view them
premier_pos.traceEmpty: No sales orders on this page
premier_pos.traceChooseOrder: Select an order to inspect its lifecycle
premier_pos.traceDisclaimer: Only official Sales and WMS records are shown. Movements referencing shipments rather than orders may be omitted; no movements is not proof of no stock deduction. Each source is limited to the first 100 rows. Paid does not mean delivered.
premier_pos.setupDescription: Inspect this organization and create missing records through official Open Mercato modules
premier_pos.setupCaution: This uses the current production database. Nothing is saved until you click Create, and created records persist. This screen never creates invoices, payments, or stock movements.
premier_pos.setupUnavailable: Cannot read or insufficient permissions. Open native module settings.
premier_pos.setupSaved: Saved through the official module. Check the refreshed list.
premier_pos.setupWarehouseLocationHint: The new dock location will belong to the selected warehouse only.
premier_pos.setupNext: Next: configure a catalog product, variant and price. No financial or stock records are created automatically.
premier_pos.catalogSetupDescription: Create a product, SKU variant, price kind, channel offer and price using the native catalog, one step at a time
premier_pos.catalogSetupPrerequisites: Set up active EGP currency and the DEV TEST sales channel above before continuing.
premier_pos.catalogSetupNotice: Each button creates a persistent official record in the current organization, subject to module permissions. The EGP 100 price excludes tax and is for development only. This does not create orders, payments or stock movements.
premier_pos.stockDescription: Receive, adjust, move and count stock using native WMS commands, balances and audit movements
premier_pos.stockWarning: Each confirmed action changes actual stock in the selected organization. WMS movement history cannot simply be undone or deleted. Review the variant, warehouse, quantity and reference before posting. These manual actions are not sales-order fulfillment, invoices or accounting entries.
premier_pos.stockDataError: WMS or catalog data unavailable. Verify module permissions and refresh.
premier_pos.stockReason: Audit reason (required for adjustments, moves and counts)
premier_pos.stockReviewNote: The next confirmation sends one official WMS command. Keep this reference for reconciliation after a network interruption.
premier_pos.stockUnknown: Result uncertain. WMS may have committed before the connection failed. Never automatically replay.
premier_pos.stockReconcile.found: Matching canonical movement found. Do not duplicate it.
premier_pos.stockReconcile.not-found: No matching movement visible yet. This does not prove the command failed; verify before a new action.
premier_pos.stockReconcile.unavailable: Canonical ledger unavailable. Preserve reference and contact the inventory supervisor.
premier_pos.stockNoBalances: No balance rows in current result
premier_pos.stockNoMovements: No movement rows in current result
premier_pos.stockPagingNote: Only the first page of canonical records is shown. Never infer all stock totals or absence of movements from incomplete data.
premier_pos.stockUntrackedLot: No existing lot / receive a new lot
premier_pos.sageExportWarning: Read-only export from the selected organization using your catalog view permission. This file includes only the first 50 products and their variants; more pages may exist. It does not change Sage, stocks, prices or manufacturing recipes.
premier_pos.parityDescription: Compare canonical Open Mercato products with a local Sage product file before migration
premier_pos.parityPrivacy: Read-only: the Sage file is never uploaded to a server, and no database records are written or changed. SKU matching is a review suggestion, never automatic identity mapping.
premier_pos.paritySourceHelp: Load native Open Mercato product pages. Bounded paging and incomplete results are explicitly identified.
premier_pos.parityFullSource: Source pagination is complete within selected scope
premier_pos.parityPartialSource: Incomplete source: results cannot represent a complete inventory
premier_pos.parityPageCap: Ten-page preview limit reached. Do not consider the source complete.
premier_pos.parityFileHelp: Select a local JSON array of Sage products (or an object with products). Each row must include id, name, sku, branch_id and product_type. Up to 5 MB; matching happens in this browser only.
premier_pos.parityResultDisclaimer: Not an import or migration approval. Branch, units, product type, prices and stock still require separate validated mappings.
premier_pos.parityTableLimit: First 200 results shown; summary counts include all loaded rows.
premier_pos.parityInstructions: Load an official catalog page and choose a local Sage product JSON file to begin comparing.
premier_pos.parityWarning.incomplete: Source pages are incomplete; SKU uniqueness cannot be established globally.
premier_pos.parityWarning.match: Matching SKU never authorizes database writes or merging records.
premier_pos.parityWarning.branch: Sage branches and product types are not mapped to native organizations or types.
premier_pos.parityWarning.finance: Prices, cost, tax, recipes, units, inventory, kitchen and balances are excluded.
premier_pos.sageCsvTitle: Compare Sage's existing Excel product export
premier_pos.sageCsvInstructions: In Sage Products, export the usual Excel file, open it in Excel and save a copy as CSV UTF-8. Select the CSV here. No changes to Sage are needed; the file is processed entirely in your browser.
premier_pos.sageCsvWarning: Important: Sage's existing export omits stable product and branch IDs. We can compare SKU overlaps only, never prove product identity or authorize an import. Prices, inventory and cost are not compared.
premier_pos.sageCsvChoose: Choose a local Sage CSV UTF-8 file
premier_pos.sageCsvErrorFormat: Select a CSV saved locally from the Sage Excel export; this view does not open XLSX directly.
premier_pos.sageCsvErrorSize: File exceeds the 5 MB local comparison limit.
premier_pos.sageCsvLoadSource: Load an Open Mercato catalog page above to view the comparison.
premier_pos.sageCsvReportWarning: This local report never authorizes migration. Excel-to-CSV may strip leading SKU zeros: inspect original cells. No Sage data is uploaded.
